scope: Offline code validation fixes and operator-reported observation reconciliation only

loggingEvidenceValidation.scope: Structured conservative evidence gate; not live logging clearance
loggingEvidenceValidation.change: Observer no longer accepts bare clearance boolean/reference without reviewed settings, inspection provenance/deadline/transport and provider/runtime/audit review evidence. Packet flat PASS cannot bypass the assessment.

reconciliationValidation.scope: Receipt contract hardening; no terminal authority invented
reconciliationValidation.change: Explicit target/attempt/hash/source correlation, rollback success, checkpoint/digest, integer chronology/freshness, label uniqueness and strict fact types; cancellation and failed metadata block confirmation.

credentialSourceInspection.limits: No automatic Dashboard/secret-store/environment credential retrieval exists in this channel; no real credential read or authority verified.

authoritativeCompletionSourceInspection.availableMechanism: createA02TerminalReceiptReader consumes externally reviewed exact-ID/hash receipt files, followed by independent observer state.
authoritativeCompletionSourceInspection.limits: Importer, executor response, hash or absent row is not an authoritative commit/drain source. No real Auth-create or provisioning finality producer was identified.
